about_the_game:
Escape or Descend Further? Greed is the Right Choice!

Choosing to escape means forfeiting the chance to seize more and better treasures!
Each descent to a deeper floor promises greater rewards, but also greater danger. If you die during a run, you’ll lose all items on your characters—or even the characters themselves.
You can spend gold to strengthen your squad mid-run, but this reduces the amount of gold you can extract. Still, escaping with some gold is better than losing it all!

Only 60 Seconds

Each run gives you just 60 seconds to fend off monsters, search for treasure chests, and gather resources.

Unique Squads

Recruit members at the tavern—each with distinct stats and traits. Customize their weapons and gear to forge unique combat styles.
Surviving runs lets your squad level up, and you can freely allocate their earned attribute points.

A Greedy Squad

Your squad demands wages and claims a share of the loot. You could refuse… but you’ll face the consequences!

short_description: Greed Squad is a game that combines roguelike elements, strategic extraction timing, and party management. Balance your gold expenditures to maximize loot extraction at minimal cost. Strengthen and optimize your team to overcome impossible odds!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
